Label: Wubaholics
Requirements: Targets 3-5 track EPs; private SoundCloud link w/ DL enabled required; 4-6 week turnaround; no fee, no genre gate stated
Notes: Boca Raton FL, est. April 2020. Also runs the "Wubaholics Anonymous" mix series - a second door where you submit a full mix instead of tracks, via their SoundCloud/socials.

Label: DUPLOC
Requirements: VA-only since the Q3 2025 label reset - now releases only 5-track compilations (DUPLOC//001 onward), no more artist EPs. No exclusivity required. Wants danceable/DJ-playable tracks; no specific sound required post-reset.
Notes: One-man label run by Pieter Grauwels (Belgium, also a practicing lawyer). Confirmed directly in his own words on Reddit: "always listening to everything.'' A new 5-track VA drops roughly every 4-6 weeks - a genuinely high-throughput door.

Label: Deadbeats
Requirements: 4 fields: artist name, tell us about yourself, track links (Dropbox/private SoundCloud), socials. No fee, no genre gate, no mastering bar.
Notes: Zeds Dead's label. Was #1 on Beatport's 140/Deep Dubstep chart at time of research. Simplest door of any major label checked in this whole project.

Label: Jadu Dala
Requirements: Send private links to demo tracks. No genre restriction, no mastering bar, no track minimum stated.
Notes: Philadelphia, founded 2016 by Nathaniel Kosko + Jesse Babini.

Label: UKF
Requirements: Not detailed in this research pass - found incidentally while researching DUPLOC's history.
Notes: Major bass-music media brand/label umbrella, not a small independent.

Label: Wormhole Music Group
Requirements: Public submissions closed per their Linktree. Patreon $5+ tier allows 2 submissions/month as an alternate route.
Notes: Oakland CA. Their entire Beatport top 10 is artists Nick already plays - the closest sonic match of any label checked, sales-invisible but editorially strong.

Label: Deep Dark & Dangerous
Notes: Christchurch NZ, run by TRUTH (Andre Fernandez + Tristan Roake). Bridges 8 different DUPLOC-roster artists - the strongest signal in the entire ladder sweep.

Label: Odyzey Music
Notes: Was flagged in earlier research as "the biggest unchecked door" for weeks - now confirmed open. Home to Of The Trees, SAKA, Chmura, rSUN, Yoko, Super Future.

Label: Trippy Bee Records
Requirements: Artist name, email, Instagram link, private SoundCloud/Dropbox link. No genre gate stated.
Notes: LSDREAM's label, launched Sept 2025 - young and actively building its roster. Arguably the most receptive door on this whole list.

Label: SubCarbon Records
Requirements: Email only - they explicitly state they do not answer SoundCloud messages.
Notes: Founded by Ganja White Night, Brussels. Found independently by two separate research passes, so treat as solid.

Label: Locus Sound
Notes: London-based, established in Manchester 2017.

Label: Infernal Sounds
Notes: Stoke-on-Trent, UK.

Label: WiddFam
Notes: Runs its own yearly VA/compilation series; same inbox appears to serve both general and comp submissions.

Label: MorFlo Records
Notes: Founded by Mersiv. Contact page is explicitly labeled "Contact + Submissions."

Label: Vision Recordings
Requirements: MP3 only, no WAV. Fields: email, private SoundCloud link (DL enabled), artist name, track title, type (Original/Remix), recipient tier, signed status.
Notes: Netherlands DnB-core label (Sleepnet, Thys, Noisia) - 140/dubstep is a visible but secondary lane, not their main sound. Don't expect a 140-first read.

Label: Aspire Higher
Notes: Not independently re-verified on-site this pass - surfaced consistently across search results for their "Tune Tuesday" series and EP/album submissions. The only small label bridging both target rosters.

Label: Good Society
Notes: LA party brand with a label attached. Only public contact is a text line for event invites, not music. Genuinely curator/relationship-driven, not a cold-submission target.

Label: Artikal Music UK
Notes: Run by J:Kenzo & Mosaix. The original Ltd company dissolved in 2018 though releases continue; no working website or email found, only a generic Bandcamp contact-message link.

Label: Sound in Picture
Notes: Sofia, Bulgaria - label/photography-magazine hybrid. Only a generic Bandcamp contact-message link found.

Label: Foundation Audio
Notes: Bristol, founded 2013 by Chad Dubz. Only a generic Bandcamp contact-message link; a 2022 community thread shows a buyer getting no reply for weeks via Bandcamp/SoundCloud DM.

Label: Subsidia
Notes: Excision-adjacent corporate imprint. No contact/submit page on site, no public LabelRadar profile. Likely routes entirely through management - treat as closed until proven otherwise.
